# Juniper Studio LLC

> Professional recording studio near Fort Smith, Arkansas (Central City, AR), offering tracking, mixing, mastering, and full production for artists and bands. By-appointment, with a full in-house guitar/amp/keys/drums backline and live sound rig.

Juniper Studio LLC is a professional recording facility built around a high-end signal chain (API, BAE, Purple Audio, Fairchild, Neumann, Royer, Coles, AEA) and a comfortable, creative environment. Artists can walk in with nothing but their songs — guitars, amps, a Steinway piano, and a full drum kit are all available in-house.

## Location & Contact
- Address: 200 E Central Ave, Central City, AR 72941 (Fort Smith, AR metro). By appointment only.
- Phone / Text: (615) 664-9985
- Email: Info@JuniperStudioLLC.com
- Hours: Mon–Fri 6pm–10pm, Saturday 10am–10pm, Sunday closed
- Booking: https://juniperstudiollc.com/contact.html
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/juniperstudiollc/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/JuniperStudioLLC
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@JuniperStudioLLC

## Service Area
Central City & Fort Smith, AR (home base). Regularly serving artists from Fayetteville, Rogers, Bentonville, Little Rock, Conway, and Russellville, AR, plus Tulsa and Oklahoma City, OK, and Nashville, TN. Remote mixing and mastering available nationwide.

## Services & Rates
- [Recording](https://juniperstudiollc.com/services.html): $100/hr (2hr minimum, then $50/hr) — tracking in a treated room with a premium signal chain, includes basic editing and comping.
- [Mixing](https://juniperstudiollc.com/services.html): $200/song — full mix from tracked or raw stems, unlimited revisions.
- [Mastering](https://juniperstudiollc.com/services.html): $75/song — stereo mastering for streaming, vinyl, and broadcast.
- [Mix + Master Bundle](https://juniperstudiollc.com/services.html): $250/song.
- [Production](https://juniperstudiollc.com/services.html): $750/song — beat-making, arrangement, sound design, full production.
- [Album Packages](https://juniperstudiollc.com/services.html): 3 songs $1,500, 5 songs $2,000, 10 songs $3,000 — includes recording, mixing, mastering, and project management.
- [Re-amping & Tone Services](https://juniperstudiollc.com/services.html): $25/hr — re-amp DI tracks through boutique amps/cabs, amp profiling (NAM/Kemper) available.

## Gear Highlights
Full list: https://juniperstudiollc.com/gear.html
- Microphones: Royer R-121, Coles 4038, AEA R44, AEA R88, Beyerdynamic M160, Neumann U47 FET, Lewitt LCT 1040, Sennheiser MD 421, Shure SM57, AKG D12VR
- Preamps & Outboard: API 512c, API 3124V, 2x BAE 1073, loaded API 8-slot rack, Purple Audio MC77, Black Lion Audio "Bluey", BBB Fairchild 670, Audioscape LA2A
- Monitoring: Barefoot MicroMain27
- Interfaces: 2x Universal Audio Apollo x16, Universal Audio Apollo Twin
- DAWs: Universal Audio Luna, Avid Pro Tools, Reaper
- Backline: custom shop Gibsons, vintage Marshall/Fender amps, Steinway upright piano, full drum kit, in-house PA for live sound
